description: Checks whether a name/handle is available on 70+ platforms at once: domain names (.com, .fr, .io, .app…), social networks (Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube…), creative and dev platforms (GitHub, Behance…), e-commerce, freelance, gaming and company registries. Takes 5-15 s on first call (results cached 10 min). Statuses: available, likely_available, taken, manual (cannot be checked automatically), unknown (check failed). Never present manual/unknown results as available. Available domains come with a registration link.

categories.description: Optional: only return these categories (all by default)

name.description: Name or handle to check (2-50 chars: letters, digits, . - _)

name: check_name
title: Check a name everywhere
